text:
maria: Developer preview: async Hosted API endpoints are live for developer keys today. This adds background job semantics and a callback/webhook flow for long-running tool integrations. Docs + quickstart here: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/async-preview :rocket:

samira: Yay! 🎉 Preview keys distributed to orgs flagged in the console under Settings -> Previews. If you want access ping me or open a support ticket.

cheng: Quick Q — does this replace streaming for tool-calls or sit alongside?

samira: It sits alongside streaming. Use the Async endpoints when call latency can be minutes or when you want server-side callbacks. Streaming remains best for interactive low-latency sessions.

maria: High level: POST /v1/async/runs to create a run, then optional webhook callback or poll GET /v1/async/runs/:id. We added an "accept_partial" mode for progressive outputs. GA planned in ~6 weeks pending feedback.

samira: Example POST (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/async/runs 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_PREVIEW_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-compact-1","input":"run extraction job","callback_url":"https://hooks.example.com/redwood-cb"}'
```

samira: Node SDK preview (v1.12.0):
```js
import { AsyncClient } from '@redwood/sdk';
const c = new AsyncClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_PREVIEW_KEY });
const run = await c.createRun({ model: 'mosaic-compact-1', input: '...', callbackUrl: 'https://...' });
console.log(run.id);
```

deploy-bot: Canary: async-endpoints v0.9 rolling out to us-west-2 now (teams flagged for preview). Monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/async-canary :gear:

zane: How are quotas/limits for preview? Any special throttling semantics?

maria: Preview limits: 10 concurrent runs per org, 5000 run creations/day per preview key. Callback retries follow exponential backoff with 5 attempts. We'll tune before GA.

lee: Will logs for async runs appear in the Console traces page?

samira: Yes — runs show in Observability -> Async Runs. You get token-level cost, timing per phase (ingest, execution, callback).

cheng: Region question: are async workers regional or global? If I create run from eu-west1 will compute stay there?

maria: Async routing respects region param and customer tier. Preview currently supports us-west-2 and eu-west-1. You can pass "region":"eu-west-1" in request or pin via org settings.

zane: Any migration story for customers using the old sync /tool-call endpoint?

samira: Short answer: no forced migration. We recommend clients keep streaming for interactive flows. Use async for batch or long-running tool integrations. We'll publish a migration guide with patterns and cost comparisons.

maria: Known gaps this week: retry metrics in Console are WIP, SDK docs missing a few language examples, and RBAC for callback endpoints needs polish. We're prioritizing these in the next sprint.

samira: If you want to try: add the header X-Preview-Feature: async-run when creating runs to opt-in for now.

cheng: Logging a small bug: callback signature currently omits run.metadata when callback_url present. Filing CR: #INC-4821.

maria: Thanks Cheng — team will triage. Please add repro and any logs.

lee: Any ETA on GA?

maria: Targeting GA in ~6 weeks assuming no major regressions. We'll run a limited early-availability before wide GA.

samira: Patch notes + migration guide will be up in docs repo by EOD tomorrow. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/repos/docs/async-preview/

zane: FYI ops: make sure webhook workers are added to rotation before ramp. I'll add capacity and alerting.

deploy-bot: Canary health: 12min running, 0 errors so far. Telemetry: QPS ~0.6, avg exec time 4.2s.

maria: Please drop feedback in #dev-experiments or DM me. If you find anything blocking, tag !urgent. :thumbsup:

samira: Sending an invite for a short demo tomorrow 10am PT — calendar invite sent to @eng, @product, @devex.
